children: was in the spotlight on Monday as investment firm Citi tracked delivery times for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max and found they were “slightly higher” than the delivery times for the iPhone 17 models.

“Our key observations from the first week of data are: 1) By the end of Week 1, compared with last year, delivery times for iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max models were slightly higher in US and UK, largely consistent in India, and shorter in China, although delivery times remain the longest in China among the four regions, at about four weeks for Pro and five weeks for Pro Max,” analyst Asiya Merchant wrote in a note to clients.
Merchant, who has a Buy rating and a $365 price target on Apple, added that delivery times for the iPhone 18 Pro Max are around a week longer than for the iPhone 18 Pro currently.

Separately, delivery times in the U.S., China, and the U.K. increased throughout the first week of availability, with the most significant increase coming in China for the Pro models, Merchant explained. However, they remain “largely unchanged” in India, Merchant added, which is notable given that Apple has placed increased interest in building up its brand in India in recent years.
She also noted that delivery times are “fairly consistent” across different color and storage configurations.
Earlier this month, Apple announced the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, along with its first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo. Pre-orders for that device will start on Oct. 16.

title: Delivery times for iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max 'slightly higher' than last year, Citi says
